item.title: What will happen in Swedish politics during election year 2026?
item.description: Everything in Swedish politics next year will point towards the election on September 13th. We spoke to three Swedish university professors to get their predictions on how it will play out.

item.title: Today in Sweden: a roundup of the latest news on Thursday
item.description: More trains arriving on time, parasites in Visby drinking water, new storm names for the Nordic countries, and more news from Sweden on Thursday.

item.title: Skål! A guide to glögg, Sweden's favourite Christmas drink
item.description: It's not Christmas in Sweden without glögg – the spiced wine drink served warm, often in little cups about the size of Turkish tea glasses. But what's the difference between the umpteen different glögg bottles on the shelf at Systembolaget?

item.title: How new Swedish migration rules could affect foreign residents in 2026
item.description: Several major changes to Swedish migration laws are expected in 2026. Here are the ones likely to have the biggest impact on the lives of foreigners in Sweden.

item.title: 'Not enough evidence against Swedish PM murder suspect'
item.description: Sweden's top prosecutor on Thursday said there was not enough evidence against a man the authorites had named as the chief suspect in the 1986 killing of prime minister Olof Palme.

item.title: Why do Swedes play bingo the day before Christmas Eve?
item.description: Throughout history, Swedes have stayed up late the day before Christmas Eve to get everything ready for the big day of celebrations. Since 1995, this has also included playing bingo until midnight – but why?

item.title: Former manager of Swedish star Avicii sues deceased artist's family
item.description: A former manager of Swedish superstar DJ Avicii said Tuesday that he had initiated legal proceedings to correct the "public record" regarding his alleged influence on the late artist's suicide.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: julgran
item.description: What do Christmas trees and moustaches have in common?

item.title: EU grills Sweden over passport issue for citizenship applicants
item.description: The European Commission has contacted Swedish authorities after citizens from Ireland were told that their EU passports were not sufficient proof of identity in citizenship applications.

item.title: 'Mayhem and chaos': Europe's airports demand urgent review of new border system
item.description: The association of European airports called on Thursday for an urgent review of the new EU border system, amid “mounting operational issues” that could affect the holiday season.
